title: Internal memo: Lightricks, creator of photo editing app Facetune, is splitting its consumer app unit from its GenAI unit LTX to better capture the growth in AI (Echo Wang/Reuters)
summary: Echo Wang / Reuters: Internal memo: Lightricks, creator of photo editing app Facetune, is splitting its consumer app unit from its GenAI unit LTX to better capture the growth in AI — The creator of the Facetune photo editing app, Lightricks, is splitting its consumer app business from its generative AI video platform LTX …
